description: Orbitan Brand Asset Registry — canonical inventory of all approved brand assets and their storage locations

canonical_sources.note: All approved brand assets are currently hosted on the Base44 CDN. Local vector masters are pending.

orbit_ring_favicon.usage: SVG favicon — original Orbit Ring brand element (6-R cycle), not a logo redraw
orbit_ring_favicon.note: Original vector. The Orbit Ring is an independent brand element used in OrbitanLoader.jsx. It is NOT a redraw of the Orbitan 3D logo.

orbitan_symbol_svg.reason: No vector master available. The approved Orbitan mark is a 3D raster PNG. Vector reconstruction is pending.

orbitan_wordmark_svg.reason: Wordmark is currently typographic (Sora Bold). An SVG wordmark would require font outline export.

orbitan_symbol_monochrome_dark.reason: Requires vector master for monochrome conversion

orbitan_symbol_monochrome_light.reason: Requires vector master for monochrome conversion

favicon_ico.reason: Requires multi-size raster export (16/32/48) from vector master

favicon_16x16_png.reason: Requires raster export from vector master

favicon_32x32_png.reason: Requires raster export from vector master

favicon_48x48_png.reason: Requires raster export from vector master

app_icon_192_png.reason: Using CDN raster master. Local derivative pending vector master for proper safe-zone composition.

app_icon_512_png.reason: Using CDN raster master. Local derivative pending vector master for proper safe-zone composition.

maskable_icon_192_png.reason: Requires vector master with safe-zone (80% inner circle) design. Cannot be derived from 3D raster mark.

maskable_icon_512_png.reason: Requires vector master with safe-zone (80% inner circle) design. Cannot be derived from 3D raster mark.

apple_touch_icon_180.reason: Using CDN raster master (not sized to 180x180). Local 180x180 derivative pending.

social_banner_1200x630.reason: AI-generated social banner. Not an approved master. A properly designed banner with the exact Orbitan wordmark and logo geometry is pending.

orbit_nexus_symbol_svg.reason: No vector master available. The approved Orbit Nexus mark is a raster PNG.

directory_structure.public/brand/orbitan/: Orbitan brand assets (SVG masters, lockups, monochrome variants)
directory_structure.public/brand/app-icons/: PWA and native app icons (192, 512, maskable, apple-touch, iOS 1024)

identity_config.note: This file is the single authority for all Orbitan brand rules. Every UI component MUST resolve brand values through this file.
